title: I made Pluck 'Em! - a Duck Hunt inspired roguelite with online ranking using only prompts.
author: I-want-to-say
selftext: All what you can experience in my game was created only by prompting (no code and hand crafted assets)- all assets, animations, sfx, sounds, music was ai generated. I iterated only my ideas through AI and it took me 12 hours to make it.

comments.author: I-want-to-say
comments.body: You can test my game in browser (works with mouse, controller and on mobile touch screen). Dont't forgetbto leave your score in onli e rank: https://app.moonlakeai.com/@Cycu1/0b4d1770-fbdc-4681-9f69-9b4947381da8

replies.author: I-want-to-say
replies.body:
Oh, that might be a lot to explain un details.
But in general. Before I start I alwayst try to come up with a written version of MVP I'd like to reach. Then I have two approaches - depends on the complexity of the project. Either I start with simple prompts e.g. "create game inspired by Duck Hunt" or I dump elevator pitch into ai to process. Then I wait for the result amd iterate each step until I reach the acceptable quality of current progress.
Not sure if that answear your question, but my workflow is based in small steps and a lot otlf iterations
